_readme: Replaces the report-style lines in lone-actions.js scentLines() (pin 3a9f923): 'The scent of X is on this ground.', 'Prey sign is thin.', 'Hazard sign: tar.' and the rest. Each key matches one push() in scentLines. {name} is a met cat, {pride} is a pride name. Every line states only what the code already knows: homeZones means the cat lives on this ground, the rival flag, the holder, the player's own hunt within 2 days, the preyWord band and the hazard ids. The opener is an optional first beat. Every other line keeps its current position.
openers: You lower your nose to the ground and breathe in slowly, sorting this place out scent by scent.
You stop and open your mouth a little, tasting the air.
You work slowly along the ground, nose low, stopping at every stone and stem that someone else has touched.
The wind shifts and brings you something. You turn into it and breathe in slowly.
You find a rubbing post and a scuffed patch of earth beside it, and you settle in to read what's been left there.
catKnown: {name}'s scent is everywhere here, rubbed on the stones and soaked into the earth. {name} comes this way often.

catStrange.male: A tom you don't know comes this way often. The scent is strong and fresh on every stone.
catStrange.female: A female cat you don't know comes this way often. The scent is light and clings to the stems.

rivalKnown: Deep claw marks score the ground, and they reek of {name}. It's a warning to any cat who comes this way.
rivalStrange: Deep claw marks score the ground, the earth still raw in them. Whoever left them wants passing cats to see them.

prideMarked.highcrag: Highcrag has marked this ground carefully, with marks spaced evenly along the trail.
prideMarked.bonefield: Bonefield has marked this ground heavily, sprayed high on every rock.
prideMarked.mistwood: Mistwood has marked this ground, but the marks are faint and far apart.
prideMarked.unmet: A pride you haven't met has marked this ground. The marks are strong and fresh, and there are lots of them.

ownKill: Your own kill-scent still hangs over this ground, faint now beneath everything else.

prey.rich: The ground is thick with prey-scent, and there are fresh hoofprints everywhere. This is good hunting ground.
prey.fair: There's prey-scent here, enough of it to hunt, if you're patient.
prey.thin: Prey-scent is thin and old here. Whatever lived on this ground has moved on or been eaten.

hazard.avalanche: The snow above smells wet and heavy, and the slope creaks. A loud noise could bring it all down.
hazard.bear: Bear. The scent is musky and unmistakable, and it's fresh. Your fur rises all along your spine.
hazard.cold_snap: The air has a hard, metallic bite that stings your nose. A bitter cold is coming.
hazard.flood: The earth smells of churned mud and snowmelt. The water is rising somewhere close.
hazard.lost_trail: The trails here cross and recross until the scents blur together. It would be easy to lose your way.
hazard.rockfall: Fresh stone dust hangs in the air, and loose scree lies scattered below the cliff. More rock could come down.
hazard.starvation: There's no food-smell here at all, only bones picked clean and old, cold droppings. Nothing worth hunting lives here.
hazard.tar: The sharp black stink of tar catches in your throat. There's tar close by that would trap a careless paw.
hazard.thin_ice: The ice smells wet and rotten underneath. It won't hold much weight for long.
hazard.wolves: Wolf. Many wolves, their scents layered thick on top of each other. A pack hunts this ground.

nothing: The wind has scoured this place clean. You can't pick up any scent.
